" alt="Handwritten-style CISSP thinking compass with eight decision steps and common question traps"/><div class="actions">${btn('Print compass','print','','small')}</div></div><div class="panel"><h3>Eight rules in my notebook</h3>${stepList()}</div></div><div class="panel" style="margin-top:17px"><h3>Three exceptions you must remember</h3><p>1. A confirmed active incident can demand immediate authorised containment rather than another general risk assessment.</p><p>2. Safety, legal obligations and ethical conduct constrain decisions even when a business shortcut appears convenient.</p><p>3. Technical controls can be the best answer when the question explicitly asks for a technical action at that stage.</p></div>`}
function progressView(){let missed=D.scenarios.filter(q=>data.answers[q.id]&&!data.answers[q.id].correct);let review=D.lessons.filter(l=>data.lessons[l.id]==='review');return `${pageHeader('PROGRESS & RETESTING','Measure what you can actually defend.','We separate self-rated understanding from answer performance. A small sample cannot predict your official examination result.')}
<div class="cards-4"><div class="stat-card"><small>Self-rated understood</small><strong>${completed()} / ${D.lessons.length}</strong></div><div class="stat-card"><small>Attempted questions</small><strong>${answered()} / ${D.scenarios.length}</strong></div><div class="stat-card"><small>Latest answer accuracy</small><strong>${answered()?accuracy()+'%':'—'}</strong></div><div class="stat-card"><small>Review lessons</small><strong>${review.length}</strong></div></div>
<div class="section-grid" style="margin-top:18px"><div class="panel progress-list"><h3>Domain understanding</h3>${D.domains.map(d=>`<div class="progress-row"><div>D${d.id} · ${esc(d.short)}</div><div class="mini-progress"><i style="width:${domainProgress(d.id)}%"></i></div><b>${domainProgress(d.id)}%</b></div>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="stack"><div class="panel"><h3>Weak-area recovery</h3>${missed.length?missed.map(q=>`<div class="guide-step"><span class="step-no">D${q.domain}</span><div><strong>${esc(q.title)}</strong><p>${esc(q.trap)}</p>${btn('Retry','scenario-direct',q.id,'small')}</div></div>`).join(''):'<p class="tiny">Your incorrect scenarios will be listed here after practice.</p>'}</div><div class="panel"><h3>Self-flagged review notes</h3>${review.length?review.map(l=>`<div class="guide-step"><span class="step-no">↺</span><div><strong>${esc(l.title)}</strong>${btn('Review','lesson',l.id,'small')}</div></div>`).join(''):'<p class="tiny">No lessons are currently marked “Review again”.</p>'}</div></div></div>
<div class="panel objective-mastery" style="margin-top:18px"><div class="row between" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px"><h3>62-objective knowledge map</h3><span class="tiny">Each square reflects your latest recorded scored attempt, not exam readiness.</span></div>
<div class="objective-legend"><span><i class="obj-dot obj-unseen"></i> Not tested</span><span><i class="obj-dot obj-correct"></i> Latest answer correct</span><span><i class="obj-dot obj-missed"></i> Needs practice</span></div>
${D.domains.map(d=>`<div class="obj-domain-row"><strong>D${d.id} · ${esc(d.short)}</strong><div class="obj-map">${d.objectives.map(([code,label])=>{let qs=D.scenarios.filter(q=>q.obj===code),attempted=qs.filter(q=>data.answers[q.id]),wrong=attempted.filter(q=>!data.answers[q.id].correct),cls=!attempted.length?'obj-unseen':wrong.length?'obj-missed':'obj-correct';return `<button class="obj-cell ${cls}" type="button" data-notes-action="open" data-code="${code}" title="${esc(label)} · ${attempted.length}/${qs.length} tested${wrong.length?' · '+wrong.length+' incorrect':''}" aria-label="${code} ${esc(label)}, ${attempted.length} of ${qs.length} tested, ${wrong.length} incorrect">${code}</button>`}).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}
<div class="actions">${btn('Practice unattempted','practice-unseen','','small primary')}${btn('Retest incorrect','practice-missed','','small')}</div></div>
<div class="panel" style="margin-top:18px"><h3>Your learning data</h3><p class="tiny">Stored only in this browser using local storage. Export a JSON backup if changing devices; this prototype does not have an account or backend sync.</p><div class="actions">${btn('Export progress JSON','export-progress','','small')}${btn('Clear learning progress','reset-progress','','danger small')}</div></div>`}
function practicePool(){let pool=state.practiceDomain==='all'?D.scenarios:D.scenarios.filter(q=>q.domain===Number(state.practiceDomain));if(state.practiceMode==='missed')return pool.filter(q=>data.answers[q.id]&&!data.answers[q.id].correct);if(state.practiceMode==='unseen')return pool.filter(q=>!data.answers[q.id]);return pool}
function simulatorView(){let ex=state.exam,n=D.scenarios.length;const count=practicePool().length;
if(!ex){let selected=Math.min(state.practiceLength,count),dur=Math.round(selected*1.8);return `${pageHeader('EXAM PRACTICE','Choose a focused practice set.','Original decision scenarios with full answer reasoning after the run. This is not an adaptive CISSP CAT simulation or a pass prediction.')}
<div class="exambox"><div class="eyebrow">PRACTICE SETUP</div><h3>${n} authored questions across 62 objectives</h3><p>Pick a domain or work across all eight. The answer key stays hidden until the end; questions cannot be revisited during a timed set.</p>
<div class="exam-picker"><span class="eyebrow">DOMAIN</span>${[['all','All domains'],...D.domains.map(d=>[String(d.id),`D${d.id} · ${d.short}`])].map(([id,label])=>`<button class="chip ${state.practiceDomain===id?'active':''}" data-action="exam-domain" data-id="${id}">${esc(label)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="exam-picker"><span class="eyebrow">PRACTICE</span>${[["all","All questions"],["unseen","Not yet attempted"],["missed","Incorrect answers"]].map(([mode,label])=>`<button class="chip ${state.practiceMode===mode?'active':''}" data-action="exam-mode" data-id="${mode}">${label}</button>`).join('')}<span class="tiny">Weak-area modes use the latest recorded answer and the currently selected domain.</span></div>
<div class="exam-picker"><span class="eyebrow">QUESTIONS</span>${[10,25,50,100].map(v=>`<button class="chip ${selected===v?'active':''}" data-action="exam-length" data-id="${v}" ${v>count?'disabled':''}>${v}</button>`).join('')}<span class="tiny">${count} available in this scope. ${Math.min(selected,count)} questions ≈ ${Math.round(Math.min(selected,count)*1.8)} minutes. Time allocation is for rehearsal only.</span></div>
${state.practiceDomain==='all'&&state.practiceMode==='all'&&selected===100?'<p class="tiny"><b>100-question mix:</b> D1 16 · D2 10 · D3 13 · D4 13 · D5 13 · D6 12 · D7 13 · D8 10 (mirrors domain weight targets, not official CAT difficulty).</p>':''}<div class="cards-3"><div class="stat-card"><strong>${selected}</strong><small>Questions</small></div><div class="stat-card"><strong>${dur}m</strong><small>Practice time limit</small></div><div class="stat-card"><strong>${state.practiceDomain==='all'?'8':'1'}</strong><small>Domain${state.practiceDomain==='all'?'s':''} in this set</small></div></div>
<div class="actions">${count?btn('Start timed practice →','start-exam','','primary'):'<span class="tiny">No questions in this selection. Choose another domain or practice mode.</span>'}</div></div><div class="panel" style="margin-top:15px"><p class="tiny">Official CISSP CAT: 100–150 items, 3 hours, a scaled passing score; these fixed-length sets use independently authored educational content and are not statistically calibrated. All ${n} scored questions have answer-option explanations.</p></div>`}
if(ex.done){let correct=ex.responses.filter((r,i)=>r===scenario(ex.ids[i]).correct).length;let byDomain=D.domains.map(d=>{let ids=ex.ids.map((id,i)=>({q:scenario(id),ans:ex.responses[i]})).filter(x=>x.q.domain===d.id);return {name:d.short,count:ids.length,correct:ids.filter(x=>x.q.correct===x.ans).length}}).filter(x=>x.count);return `${pageHeader('PRACTICE RESULTS','Review every decision, not just the percentage.','Your practice result is not an official ISC2 scaled score; these questions have not been psychometrically calibrated.')}
<div class="cards-3"><div class="stat-card"><small>Correct</small><strong>${correct} / ${ex.ids.length}</strong></div><div class="stat-card"><small>Practice accuracy</small><strong>${Math.round(correct/ex.ids.length*100)}%</strong></div><div class="stat-card"><small>Time used</small><strong>${Math.floor((ex.duration-Math.max(0,ex.remaining))/60)}m</strong></div></div>
<div class="panel" style="margin-top:16px"><h3>Domain performance</h3>${byDomain.map(x=>`<div class="progress-row"><div>${esc(x.name)}</div><div class="mini-progress"><i style="width:${Math.round(100*x.correct/x.count)}%"></i></div><b>${x.correct}/${x.count}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="exam-review" style="margin-top:16px"><h3>Review the question and all four alternatives</h3>${ex.ids.map((id,i)=>{let q=scenario(id),a=ex.responses[i];return `<details><summary>${a===q.correct?'✓':'↺'} ${i+1}. D${q.domain} · ${esc(q.title)} · ${a===q.correct?'Correct':'Review'}</summary><p>${esc(q.stem)}</p><p><b>Your answer:</b> ${a===null?'Unanswered':letters[a]} · <b>Best:</b> ${letters[q.correct]}</p><div class="insight"><b>Decision principle</b><p>${esc(q.principle)}</p></div>${q.options.map(([o,why],j)=>`<p class="tiny"><b>${letters[j]} ${j===q.correct?'✓':''} ${esc(o)}:</b> ${esc(why)}</p>`).join('')}</details>`}).join('')}</div>
<div class="actions">${btn('Build another practice set','reset-exam','','primary')}${btn('Review my progress','progress','','quiet')}</div>`}
let q=scenario(ex.ids[ex.pos]),left=Math.max(0,ex.remaining);return `${pageHeader('TIMED PRACTICE',`Question ${ex.pos+1} of ${ex.ids.length}`,'No explanations until the end. Look for the role, timing, constraints and the exact decision requested.')}
<div class="row between" style="margin-bottom:15px"><span class="pill">D${q.domain} · ${esc(q.keyword)}</span><span class="counter" id="exam-clock">${String(Math.floor(left/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(left%60).padStart(2,'0')} REMAINING</span></div>
<div class="scenario-card"><h3>${esc(q.title)}</h3><p class="scenario-stem">${esc(q.stem)}</p>${q.options.map(([o],i)=>`<button class="answer-option ${ex.choice===i?'selected':''}" data-action="exam-select" data-id="${i}"><span class="answer-letter">${letters[i]}</span><span>${esc(o)}</span></button>`).join('')}
<div class="actions"><button type="button" class="btn primary" data-action="exam-next" ${ex.choice===null?'disabled title="Choose an answer to continue"':''}>${ex.pos===ex.ids.length-1?'Finish and see review →':'Lock answer and continue →'}</button>${btn('End practice and review','exam-end','','quiet')}</div></div>`}
function app(){let pages={study:()=>window.CISSP_StudyDesk.render(),reference:()=>window.CISSP_Reference.render(),dashboard,contrasts:()=>window.CISSP_Contrasts.render(),notes:()=>window.CISSP_StudyNotes.index(),note:()=>window.CISSP_StudyNotes.reader(),domains:domainsView,domain:domainView,lesson:lessonView,scenarios:scenarioView,casebook:()=>window.CISSP_Casebook.render(),traps:trapsView,pivots:pivotsView,glossary:glossaryView,simulator:simulatorView,progress:progressView,compass:compassView};let content=(pages[state.page]||dashboard)();
document.body.classList.toggle('desk-mode',state.page==='study');
document.body.classList.toggle('reference-mode',state.page==='reference');
const activeDomain=Number(window.CISSP_StudyDesk.current().split('.')[0]);
$('#app').innerHTML=`<div class="app-layout"><aside class="sidebar"><div class="brand"><span class="mark">◈</span><div><h1>CISSP 2026</h1><small>Study Notes</small></div></div><nav aria-label="CISSP Domains"><div class="nav-label">CISSP Domains</div>${navigation.map(([id,number,label])=>`<button class="nav-btn ${state.page==='study'&&activeDomain===Number(id)?'active':''}" data-action="study-domain" data-id="${id}"><span class="nav-icon">${number}</span>${esc(label)}</button>`).join('')}</nav><div class="sidebar-bottom">Independent CISSP study · 2024 exam outline (through 14 April 2027).</div></aside>
<main class="main"><div class="topbar"><nav class="desk-top-nav" aria-label="Study tools">${topNav.map(([page,label])=>`<button type="button" class="${state.page===page?'active':''}" data-action="${page}">${label}</button>`).join('')}</nav></div>${content}<p class="disclaimer">Independent CISSP preparation, not endorsed by ISC2. Original questions only. <a href="${D.officialUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Official exam outline</a>, effective 15 April 2024. The new outline takes effect 15 April 2027. Use current official resources and professional judgement; no study resource guarantees an exam score.</p></main></div>`;
if(state.page==='simulator'&&state.exam&&!state.exam.done){updateTimerText()}
}
window.CISSP_RENDER=app;window.CISSP_GO=go;window.CISSP_SAVE_DESK_ANSWER=(id,correct,choice)=>{data.answers[id]={correct,choice,at:new Date().toISOString(),mode:'desk'};save()};
function go(page){state.page=page;app();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function allocateDomainCounts(pool, length){
  // Largest remainder apportionment with domain capacities: 100 full-set items follow published weights.
  const weights=D.domains.map(d=>d.weight), caps=D.domains.map(d=>pool.filter(q=>q.domain===d.id).length);
  const counts=weights.map((w,i)=>Math.min(caps[i],Math.floor(length*w/100)));
  let remaining=length-counts.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  while(remaining>0){
    let candidates=counts.map((n,i)=>({i,room:caps[i]-n,deficit:length*weights[i]/100-n})).filter(x=>x.room>0);
    if(!candidates.length)break;
    candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.deficit-a.deficit||b.room-a.room||a.i-b.i);
    counts[candidates[0].i]++;remaining--;
  }
  return counts;
}
function startExam(){
  const pool=practicePool(); const length=Math.min(state.practiceLength,pool.length);
  if(!length)return;
  let ids=[];
  if(state.practiceDomain==='all'){
    const counts=allocateDomainCounts(pool,length);
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++) ids.push(...shuffle(pool.filter(q=>q.domain===i+1)).slice(0,counts[i]).map(q=>q.id));
  }else ids=shuffle([...pool]).slice(0,length).map(q=>q.id);
  ids=shuffle(ids);
  const duration=Math.round(ids.length*108);
  state.exam={ids,pos:0,choice:null,responses:Array(ids.length).fill(null),remaining:duration,duration,done:false};
  go('simulator');
}
function finishExam(){if(!state.exam||state.exam.done)return;state.exam.done=true;for(let i=0;i<state.exam.ids.length;i++){let id=state.exam.ids[i],a=state.exam.responses[i],q=scenario(id);if(a!==null)data.answers[id]={correct:a===q.correct,choice:a,at:new Date().toISOString(),mode:'exam'}}save();go('simulator')}
function updateTimerText(){let el=$('#exam-clock');if(state.exam&&el){let t=Math.max(state.exam.remaining,0);el.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(t/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(t%60).padStart(2,'0')} REMAINING`}}
setInterval(()=>{if(state.exam&&!state.exam.done){state.exam.remaining--;if(state.exam.remaining<=0){state.exam.remaining=0;finishExam()}else updateTimerText()}},1000);
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.id==='scenario-reason'){state.reasoning=e.target.value;let el=$('#check-answer');if(el)el.disabled=state.selected===null||state.reasoning.trim().length<12}
if(e.target.id==='scenario-search'){state.scenarioSearch=e.target.value;}
if(e.target.id==='glossary-search'){state.query=e.target.value;let el=$('#glossary-list');if(el)el.innerHTML=glossaryRows()}});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button[data-action]');if(!b)return;let action=b.dataset.action,id=b.dataset.id;switch(action){
case 'study':case 'reference':case 'dashboard':case 'notes':case 'contrasts':case 'domains':case 'scenarios':case 'casebook':case 'traps':case 'pivots':case 'glossary':case 'simulator':case 'progress':case 'compass':if(action==='scenarios'){state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning=''}go(action);break;
case 'study-domain':window.CISSP_StudyDesk.openDomain(id);break;
case 'domain':window.CISSP_StudyDesk.openDomain(id);break;
case 'casebook-domain':window.CISSP_Casebook.openDomain(Number(id));break;
case 'lesson':state.lesson=id;go('lesson');break;
case 'scenario-domain':state.scenarioSearch='';state.filter=String(id);state.scenarioId=scenariosFor(state.filter)[0].id;state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';go('scenarios');break;
case 'related-scenario':{state.scenarioSearch='';let l=lesson(id),qs=D.scenarios.filter(q=>q.lesson===l.id);state.filter=String(l.domain);state.scenarioId=(qs[0]||D.scenarios.find(q=>q.domain===l.domain)).id;state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';go('scenarios');break}
case 'scenario-direct':{let q=scenario(id);state.scenarioSearch='';state.filter=String(q.domain);state.scenarioId=q.id;state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';go('scenarios');break}
case 'filter-domain':state.scenarioSearch='';state.filter=id;state.scenarioId=scenariosFor(id)[0].id;state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';go('scenarios');break;
case 'pick-answer':if(!state.submitted){state.selected=Number(id);app()}break;
case 'check-answer':if(state.selected!==null&&state.reasoning.trim().length>=12){let q=scenario(state.scenarioId);state.submitted=true;data.answers[q.id]={correct:state.selected===q.correct,choice:state.selected,at:new Date().toISOString(),mode:'scenario',reasoning:state.reasoning};save();app()}break;
case 'next-scenario':{let list=scenariosFor(state.filter),cur=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===state.scenarioId);let next=list.slice(cur+1).find(q=>!data.answers[q.id])||list.slice(0,cur+1).find(q=>!data.answers[q.id])||list[(cur+1)%list.length];state.scenarioId=next.id;state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';app();window.scrollTo(0,0);break}
case 'select-trap':state.trap=Number(id);app();break;
case 'select-pivot':state.pivot=Number(id);state.pivotSide=0;app();break;
case 'flip-pivot':state.pivotSide=1-state.pivotSide;app();break;
case 'mark-understood':data.lessons[id]='mastered';save();app();break;
case 'mark-review':data.lessons[id]='review';save();app();break;
case 'save-note':{let x=$('#study-note');if(x){data.notes[state.lesson]=x.value;save();b.textContent='✓ Saved on this device';setTimeout(()=>{if(b.isConnected)b.textContent='Save explanation'},1400)}break}
case 'print':window.print();break;
case 'exam-domain':state.practiceDomain=id;state.practiceLength=id==='all'?25:10;app();break;
case 'exam-length':state.practiceLength=Number(id);app();break;
case 'exam-mode':state.practiceMode=id;app();break;
case 'search-scenarios':state.filter='all';state.scenarioId=scenariosFor(state.filter)[0]?.id||'';state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';app();break;
case 'clear-scenario-search':state.scenarioSearch='';state.filter='all';state.scenarioId=D.scenarios[0].id;state.selected=null;state.submitted=false;state.reasoning='';app();break;
case 'start-exam':startExam();break;
case 'exam-select':if(state.exam&&!state.exam.done){state.exam.choice=Number(id);app()}break;
case 'exam-next':if(state.exam&&!state.exam.done&&state.exam.choice!==null){state.exam.responses[state.exam.pos]=state.exam.choice;if(state.exam.pos===state.exam.ids.length-1)finishExam();else{state.exam.pos++;state.exam.choice=null;app();window.scrollTo(0,0)}}break;
case 'exam-end':finishExam();break;
case 'reset-exam':state.exam=null;go('simulator');break;
case 'practice-unseen':state.exam=null;state.practiceMode='unseen';state.practiceDomain='all';state.practiceLength=10;go('simulator');break;
case 'practice-missed':state.exam=null;state.practiceMode='missed';state.practiceDomain='all';state.practiceLength=10;go('simulator');break;
case 'export-progress':{let blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({exported:new Date().toISOString(),app:'CISSP Decision Lab prototype',data},null,2)],{type:'application/json'});let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='cissp-decision-lab-progress.json';document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);break}
case 'reset-progress':if(window.confirm('Clear lesson ratings, notes and scenario answers saved in this browser? This cannot be undone unless you exported a backup.')){data.lessons={};data.answers={};data.notes={};data.review={};save();go('progress')}break;
}});
app();
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
